timeline.summary: Kaynes Technology India Limited rescheduled its Q4/FY26 earnings call to **10:00 AM IST** on **May 14, 2026**, per **Sudhasri Addepalli (ICSI ACS 79832)**.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,242.64 Cr (+26.2% YoY), net profit ₹91.22 Cr (-21.5% YoY).
Kaynes Technology reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹3,626.40 Cr, up 33.2% YoY, with an order book of ₹8,366.30 Cr.
Kaynes Technology filed monitoring agency reports for Q4FY26 confirming no material deviations in the utilization of proceeds from its two QIPs.
Kaynes Technology India Limited shared the audio recording link for its Q4FY26 earnings call held on May 14, 2026, via its website.
Kaynes Technology filed a correction for cash flow classification within financing activities for FY26 with no impact on total cash or profit.
Kaynes Technology reported Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹1,242.64 Cr and full-year FY26 revenue of ₹3,626.40 Cr, missing prior guidance due to project deferrals.
